title: Dedicated autoscaler: priority routing, burst backpressure, and utilization reporting enhancement
author: Alex Chen
description: Motivation: Customers on Dedicated fleets have reported occasional latency spikes and throttling during short load bursts. The existing token-bucket autoscaler grants burst tokens per-fleet but lacks fine-grained priority routing and upstream backpressure integration. This PR introduces: 1) priority-aware routing so high-priority tenants get reserved burst capacity during contention, 2) a backpressure signal path from serving nodes to the autoscaler to gracefully shed low-priority burst requests, 3) richer utilization reporting (per-priority, per-fleet) and Grafana dashboards to surface transient saturation events, and 4) minor token-bucket smoothing and throughput guarantee fixes discovered during incident postmortem (SUP-778). What changed (summary): Implemented a priority routing layer in the autoscaler and scheduler, extended the token-bucket to account for priority reservations, added a backpressure controller that exposes a short-lived shed flag from serving nodes, and added observability hooks: prometheus metrics, per-route traces for burst events, and a Grafana dashboard. Code + tests + infra/dashboard included. Checklist: - [x] Design doc and Linear ticket referenced (ENG-2412) - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Metrics and dashboard updated - [x] Feature gated behind experiment flag (autoscaler.priority_burst=true) - [x] Rollout plan in description. Rollout plan: Feature gated. Canary deploy to two Dedicated regions for 24h, monitor new metrics (dedicated_autoscaler_priority_drop_rate, dedicated_autoscaler_reserved_burst_tokens, dedicated_autoscaler_backpressure_events). If no regressions, enable for larger fleet and remove gate after 4 weeks. Related: ENG-2489 covers the utilization reporting schema; SUP-778 incident notes drove token-bucket smoothing thresholds. Links: Linear/ENG-2412, Linear/ENG-2489, SUP-778.

review_comments: Ravi Kumar (review): The priority reservation looks good, but can we bound the memory growth when many tenants set high priority? Suggested: cap reservation map and evict LRU entries.
Alex Chen (reply): Added an LRU cap with config default 10k entries; documented in helm values. See commit g9d0a33.
Priya Patel (review): Backpressure path LGTM. Please add a short-circuit so very short-lived spikes (<100ms) don't trigger shed logic to avoid oscillation.
Alex Chen (reply): Added 100ms debounce on node-side backpressure emission; updated tests to cover debounce behavior.
Jordan Smith (review): Tests are comprehensive. One minor nit on metric label naming for Prometheus consistency.
Alex Chen (reply): Renamed label from 'priority_level' to 'tenant_priority' to match conventions and updated dashboard.
